result.summary:
Step 0.5 (registry lookup): grepped docs/issues/*.yaml for rehears|assertion.run|apply_review|assertion_run -- 7 hits (ISS-0733, ISS-0732 itself, ISS-0735, ISS-0731, ISS-0730, ISS-0214, ISS-0109). None is a prior fix of THIS defect (apply_review/4 never checking a passed assertion run before releasing): ISS-0731 (resolved) is a frontend rehearsal-response-shape mismatch; ISS-0730 (resolved) is about compute_promotion_plan/5 and the rehearsal-rerun endpoint's own mechanics, not a gate on apply; ISS-0214/ISS-0109 (status: instrumented, not resolved) are migration-ordering/table-existence flakes in promotion_assertion_rerun tests, unrelated to gating logic. ISS-0733 (resolved, same run's sibling, WF03-ISS0733-20260921) fixed a DIFFERENT gap in the SAME module -- missing audit/read-path for DEFINITION_PROMOTED events -- not release gating; it is related context only (confirms promotion.ex was touched very recently and is still under active fix cycles) and not a prior fix of this defect. No recurrence; this is a genuinely new, unfixed gap.

Step 1 (root cause, confirmed by direct code reading): lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex:586-592 apply_review/4's `with` chain is exactly: {:ok, review} <- PromotionReviewStore.get_review/2, :ok <- verify_apply_digest(review, plan_digest) [promotion.ex:594-600, compares review.plan_digest via PromotionDigest.verify_digest/2], :ok <- verify_approved(review) [promotion.ex:602-603, pattern-matches status: :approved only] -- then unconditionally calls do_apply_review/3 (:605) -> promote_definition/3. There is no fourth precondition and no call anywhere in apply_review/4, do_apply_review/3, or promote_definition/3 to Letflow.Definitions.get_latest_assertion_run/2 or any other assertion-run lookup. Grepped lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex and lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_review_store.ex for 'assertion' and 'rehears' -- zero matches in both files. Root cause confirmed exactly as ISS-0732.yaml states, not merely trusted: apply_review/4 can transition a review straight from :approved to :applied with zero PromotionAssertionRun ever having existed for it.

get_latest_assertion_run/2 return shape (lib/letflow/definitions.ex:1175-1197): @spec is (review_id, opts) :: {:ok, PromotionAssertionRun.t()} | {:error, :not_found}. On no run existing (or an un-castable review_id) it returns {:error, :not_found} -- NOT {:ok, nil} -- so a fix's `with` chain can pattern-match {:ok, run} <- get_latest_assertion_run(...) directly. It queries `from(r in PromotionAssertionRun, where: r.review_id == ^uuid, order_by: [desc: r.started_at, desc: r.id], limit: 1)`, i.e. the most recent run only. PromotionAssertionRun's schema (lib/letflow/definitions/promotion_assertion_run.ex:52-76): the digest field is `plan_digest :string` (64-char lowercase hex, validated at insert), and the failure-count field is `assertions_failed :integer, default: 0` (written once by update_changeset/2 alongside status/assertions_total/assertions_passed/failing_assertion_ids/completed_at). `status` is a separate 4-value Ecto.Enum (:running/:passed/:failed/:teardown_failed) that is NOT the field to gate on.

Gate condition to mirror (lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex moduledoc, '## The assertion-run gate condition (design §7.5)', lines 119-127): R8's own 200-vs-422 split keys on assertions_failed == 0, explicitly NOT on status == :passed -- confirmed in code at promotions.ex:720-721 (render_run_assertions matches %{assertions_failed: 0} => 200) and :727-728 (n > 0 => 422). The moduledoc states this is deliberate: a status: :teardown_failed result with assertions_failed == 0 still counts as a green gate, and porting an R-Co-style `result.status != .failed` check would silently disagree with that already-documented contract.

Fix needed (not implemented here): apply_review/4's `with` chain needs a new precondition evaluated after verify_approved(review) and before do_apply_review/3 is called -- something equivalent to `{:ok, assertion_run} <- get_latest_assertion_run(review.id, opts)`, `:ok <- verify_digest_match(assertion_run.plan_digest, plan_digest)` (the assertion run must be for the SAME plan_digest currently being applied, not a stale run against an older plan), then `:ok <- verify_assertions_passed(assertion_run)` implemented as `assertions_failed == 0` (mirroring promotions.ex's R8 condition), each mapped to a distinct {:error, ...} reason (e.g. :no_assertion_run, :assertion_run_digest_mismatch, :assertions_failed) so callers/tests can distinguish cases. This is backend business-logic scope requiring CODE-DESIGNER + ELIXIR-DEV + SECURITY-REVIEWER + REVIEWER + TEST-DESIGNER, plus a corresponding FRONTEND-DEV follow-up for web/src/components/NonSkippableApprovalGate.tsx to surface a 'release blocked -- rehearsal required' state once the backend returns one.

issues.description: Confirmed by direct code reading: apply_review/4 (lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex:586-592) has no precondition on Letflow.Definitions.get_latest_assertion_run/2 -- a review can be applied immediately after approval with zero PromotionAssertionRun ever having run, releasing an unrehearsed change. Root cause and required fix shape are stated in full in result.summary.

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER: design a new precondition step in apply_review/4's `with` chain (lib/letflow/definitions/promotion.ex), evaluated after verify_approved/1 and before do_apply_review/3, that calls Letflow.Definitions.get_latest_assertion_run/2, verifies the returned run's plan_digest matches the plan_digest being applied, and verifies assertions_failed == 0 (mirroring lib/letflow/routers/promotions.ex's documented R8 gate condition, NOT status == :passed). Design must also account for the corresponding frontend gap in web/src/components/NonSkippableApprovalGate.tsx (no 'rehearsal required' blocked state exists today).
